description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - The Collective Agreement entered into between Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited and the Jathika Sewaka Sangamaya with others, regarding the Executive Grades
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited and several trade unions under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions regarding employment terms, conditions, and dispute resolution procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks governing labor relations, specifically published in accordance with Section 06 of the Industrial Disputes Act.
